description: Cid Harbour Research Shark Catch Report is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Primary Industries. Raw data from researchers Richard Fitzpatrick and Adam Barnett from Biopixel Oceans Foundation on the number, species and coordinates of sharks captured in Cid Harbour. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Primary Industries. Its tags are Cid harbour, shark catch, sharks. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2022-06-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
